en.headline: Hong Kong men's foil team takes silver at Fencing World Championships
en.dek: The team of Ryan Choi, Cheung Ka-long, Harris Ho and Leung Chin-yu secured Hong Kong's first-ever team silver medal after a narrow final loss to Italy.
body: The Hong Kong, China men's foil team won the silver medal in the team event at the Fencing World Championships 2026 held in Hong Kong, marking the city's first team silver in the discipline at the world championships.

Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law congratulated the athletes, praising their outstanding performance and determination. She said the result made history and expressed hope that the team would continue to strive for excellence at the Asian Games in September.
The squad comprising Ryan Choi, Cheung Ka-long, Harris Ho and Leung Chin-yu finished as runners-up after a closely contested final against Italy. The championships are being staged at AsiaWorld-Expo.

zh.headline: 港隊男子花劍團體賽奪世錦賽銀牌 史上首面
zh.dek: 由蔡俊彥、張家朗、何瑋棋及梁千又組成的港隊在決賽不敵意大利，奪得香港在世錦賽花劍團體項目首面銀牌。
body: 香港中國男子花劍隊在2026年世界劍擊錦標賽團體賽奪得銀牌，成為香港在世錦賽花劍團體項目歷史上的首面銀牌。
文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩祝賀選手，讚揚他們表現出色、堅毅不屈。她表示成績創下歷史，並期望隊伍在9月亞運會繼續力爭佳績。
由蔡俊彥、張家朗、何瑋棋及梁千又組成的港隊在決賽與意大利展開激烈爭持後獲得亞軍。今屆世錦賽於亞洲國際博覽館舉行。
